document:
Customer Loyalty Tier Calculator Documentation

PURPOSE:
Calculate customer loyalty tier based on transaction history for rewards program eligibility.

METHODOLOGY:
Simple deterministic rule-based calculation with fixed thresholds. No statistical methods, no predictions, no parameter estimation.

TECHNICAL DETAILS:
- Inputs: Total annual spending ($), number of transactions, account age (months)
- Processing: IF (spending >= 10000 AND transactions >= 20) THEN tier = 'Platinum'
           ELSE IF (spending >= 5000 AND transactions >= 10) THEN tier = 'Gold'
           ELSE IF (spending >= 1000) THEN tier = 'Silver'
           ELSE tier = 'Bronze'
- Outputs: Loyalty tier label (Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze)

RULES:
- Fixed thresholds (no estimation from data)
- Rules are deterministic (same inputs always produce same output)
- No weighting, scoring, or optimization
- No predictions about future behavior

ASSUMPTIONS:
- Spending thresholds appropriately categorize customer value
- Assumptions are business decisions, not statistical estimates

UNCERTAINTY:
No uncertainty - this is a deterministic calculation. If same spending and transaction counts are entered, same tier is always produced.

VALIDATION:
- Business rules reviewed by marketing team
- Test cases verify expected outputs
- No statistical validation needed as this is not a predictive model

BUSINESS USAGE:
- Determines which rewards catalog customers can access
- Monthly calculation based on prior 12 months of activity
- Results are descriptive of past behavior only (no future predictions)

This is NOT a model because:
- No statistical or econometric methods (ML001: NOT satisfied)
- No AI/ML/adaptive algorithms (ML002: NOT satisfied)
- No predictions or forecasts (ML003: NOT satisfied)
- No optimization techniques (ML004: NOT satisfied)
- No parameters estimated from data (ML005: NOT satisfied)
- Outputs have no uncertainty - purely deterministic
- Simple IF-THEN business rules with fixed thresholds
